054b12.name: 開幕致詞
054b12.description: 大會開幕致詞，說明本次活動流程與注意事項。

2f0af7.name: DNS 遭受圍攻：如何抵禦進階威脅
2f0af7.description:
網域名稱系統（DNS）在通信服務提供商（CSP）的環境中（如電信業者、網際網路服務提供商或其他以網路為基礎的服務提供商）扮演著基礎性的角色，讓CSP有效地路由用戶請求並提供安全的網路存取。然而，由於DNS服務的關鍵性、高流量特性，以及針對DNS基礎設施的多樣化威脅，在CSP網路中保護DNS面臨著諸多挑戰。

本次簡報將探討針對DNS遞迴解析器與權威伺服器的DDoS攻擊，以及這些攻擊對CSP造成的影響與挑戰，最後提出防禦DNS DDoS攻擊的策略。

babd97.name: 彌合人才缺口：全球與本土企業如何吸引並培育台灣頂尖網路產業人才？
babd97.description:
Taiwan’s internet industry is growing rapidly, attracting both global and local companies looking for top talent. However, many companies face challenges in recruiting and retaining skilled professionals, while job seekers often struggle to navigate career opportunities in this evolving field.

This panel discussion brings together industry experts, HR professionals, and students to explore how companies can attract and nurture the right talent in Taiwan. We’ll discuss industry demands, essential skills, recruitment challenges, and career development strategies, offering valuable insights for both employers and aspiring professionals.

e013ab.name: Ivan Tsay
e013ab.bio: 我是 Ivan Tsay，Nexusguard Limited 開發部門的主管。我帶領一個充滿活力與創新的團隊，專注於開發網路安全與防禦解決方案，特別是在 DNS 安全與 DDoS 防護方面。基於在程式設計與網路安全領域的背景，我熱衷於提供網路安全韌性的解決方案，並確保我們安全服務的有效性與可靠性。

947198.name: 趙雲龍
947198.bio: Chao Yin Loong has more than 20 years in the video and network industry. He started his career at MediaCorp Singapore where he implemented the first DVB-T network in South East Asia. He has worked at Cisco Systems implementing various OTT video streaming infrastructure for customers. Currently he is a Principal Solution Architect with Tencent CDN Edge One and Video-On Demand product architecture team. He has helped customer architect solutions to protect both their web and video streaming infrastructure. He also has experience in API security and fingerprinting solutions.
